supporting_observations.claim: The alerted transfer is visible: FILE-NWD-01 (10.40.20.20) sent 640,000,221 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 in a connection beginning at 13:45:28 UTC, near the alert time.
A second, smaller HTTP connection from FILE-NWD-01 to the same proxy occurred at 13:45:28 UTC, but the available connection records do not identify the upstream destination or application.

The transfer's size is consistent with the environment's description of StratoSafe offsite backups, but the available record does not establish that this connection was to StratoSafe or was generated by its approved stsynchronization agent.

A Kerberos service-ticket event for svc-archive targeting FILE-NWD-01 came from 139.162.174.124 shortly before the transfer. Its relationship, if any, to the transfer is not established by the available records.

known_telemetry_limitations: FILE-NWD-01 winsec and sysmon logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, preventing process, account, and host-event attribution for the transfer during that interval.
PROXY-NWD-01 proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so the upstream destination, URL, and proxy-level request details for the transfer are unavailable.
Zeek connection telemetry is available and records the large transfer, but the supplied record does not identify the originating process or the external destination beyond the proxy.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer reached stratosafe-backup.com or another destination.
Whether C:\Program Files\StratoSafe\stsync.exe or another process initiated the transfer.
Whether the svc-archive ticket from 139.162.174.124 was legitimate or connected to the transfer.
Whether the data transferred was authorized backup data or data exfiltrated maliciously.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:45–13:46 UTC, including the upstream destination, URL, authenticated identity, and request details.
Recover FILE-NWD-01 process and security telemetry for the alert interval, especially process/network attribution and relevant service or scheduled-task activity.
Verify StratoSafe transfer records for the timestamp, amount, destination, and svc-archive authentication, including whether the external-IP ticket is expected.
unrelated_findings: WS-NBLAKE-01 user nora.blake initiated an RDP session to FILE-NWD-01 at 13:34 UTC. This appears outside the stated remote-administration practice, which permits remote administration only from WS-SOKAFOR-01; assess separately and do not use it to determine this transfer's disposition.
